body.h: In this game you pass on three count and you decide whether to make straight or crossed passes every time you pass. So on any pass both jugglers might pass with the same hand or they might both pass with different hands. Also both jugglers might pass straight, both might pass crossed or one passes straight and the other crossed. There is the potential for collisions, but you can reduce this by passing towards the outside of the pattern.
This game becomes much more interesting if you allow double and triple passes. These passes can also be straight or crossed.
